text: Use layout_cluster when diagnostics indicate a top-level node exceeds the artboard, a background-like rect should become the artboard fill, a child exceeds a bounded frame, or parent/child scales are inconsistent. Do not use it just because a single text box overflows; prefer a normal modify-only repair.

Within the diagnosed cluster the repair may modify p/s, fill/hug/fixed values, adjust auto-layout g/pad/x/y, enable wrap_text, resize the affected parent or root artboard (s(fill,fill)), convert a background rect into an artboard fill when the repair request grants it, update affected descendants.

Even in layout_cluster, do not delete the page, delete unrelated nodes, change unrelated slots/tokens/logos/assets/copy, regenerate the whole scene, change page/export dimensions unless targeted, hardcode numeric root sizes, or use mm/renderer pixels for child coordinates.

Prefer modify lines; root artboard sizing s(fill,fill); do not write #node al(...) or #node wrap(...) in a repair; use wrap_text(true), g/pad/x/y. When a background-rect conversion cannot be a safe modify-only block, use a checked structured edit with a scope containing only the diagnosed cluster.
Feedback To The Author: pass the exact diagnostics and name the cluster (repair class, artboard id, root frame id, parent id, descendant ids, allowed properties, prohibitions).
note: Trio leftover: written for an orchestrator handing a repair to an author subagent.
